text: Bloor explains how a flexible business obligation can still be enforceable. It identifies the promised objective, considers the promisor’s financial capacity, examines concrete decisions, and gives a workable damages method.
sourceSummary: Falstaff’s best-efforts promise required attention to Ballantine’s sales volume; concentrating on Falstaff’s overall profits while allowing that volume to collapse did not satisfy the agreement.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
